protocol.fullOperation: MoonBit JSON-in/JSON-out plus client JSON decoding; all evidence retained
protocol.summaryStatistic: Median of the corresponding three per-process statistics
protocol.semanticComparison: All full-output values must match frozen v0.1.0; only root version and shrink report.version are normalized
protocol.phaseCaveat: Prepared-input phase hooks are separate diagnostic operations, not additive end-to-end stages

releaseGate.scope: All 20 frozen common full-output workloads; phases are diagnostic

evidencePersistence.scheme: Immutable numbered snapshots with payload/file SHA-256 and atomic latest pointer
evidencePersistence.stagingCaveat: Orphan/partial staging files are never pointer targets; recovery without a valid pointer cannot claim completion
evidencePersistence.durabilityCaveat: Files are fsynced before publication; cross-platform power-loss directory durability is not guaranteed

phases.semanticAgreement: Covered by the matching full-output scenario

caveat: Same-machine direct comparison. Smoke cannot satisfy release acceptance. v0.1.8 speedup/RSS targets are not v0.1.1 gates.

originalBaselineProtocol.fullOperation: MoonBit JSON-in/JSON-out plus client JSON decoding; full evidence retained
originalBaselineProtocol.phaseCaveat: Phase hooks prepare input outside timed section; phases do not sum to full analysis.
